BehaviorTree._description: Stack blue on red, then unstack it to a random spot, num_cycles times, recording each leg as one MoveIt Pro episode labelled with its language prompt. A leg counts only once the scene camera confirms its result; on a motion failure the leg attempts home recovery, keeping the jaw command if it may hold a cube, its unsaved episode is discarded and the cycle stops.

SubTree.input_port: Stack-then-unstack cycles to run; each records two episodes.
Recorded MoveIt Pro dataset the episodes are added to.
Named training config giving the recorded topics and rate; see config/training/rebot_bench_jpeg.json.
Wait after starting each episode's recording before the leg moves.
